label: TP
reason: User-controlled input flows directly to unsanitized response output without encoding. The XSS finding shows param (from getTheValue) reaches response.getWriter().println() concatenated without escaping. The insecure randomness uses java.util.Random.nextInt() for session tokens which is cryptographically weak.

evidence.note: java.util.Random.nextInt() used for session token generation (insecure randomness)
